== Description ==

[[Anthony Howard]] (left, black "Return to Tradition" T-shirt) playing [[Jack Douglass]] (right, black T-shirt, ponytail, glasses, and beard) at a table in the hall at the [[2025 World Championship]] on 5 October 2025, with [[Mark Billings]] (background, patterned cardigan, ponytail, and glasses).
